raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: Диаграмата представя групирана стълбовидна диаграма, която илюстрира точността (Accuracy) на шест различни метода върху три бенчмарка. Хоризонталната ос съдържа три категории — Mathverse, MMLU и Physics — подредени отляво надясно. Вертикалната ос е етикетирана като „Accuracy (%)" и обхваща диапазон от приблизително 50% до 62%, със скала на интервали от 2 процентни пункта (50, 52, 54, 56, 58, 60, 62). За всяка категория са представени шест стълба, съответстващи на шест метода, обозначени в легендата в горната част на диаграмата: DAPO+Self-reflection (плътен син), DAPO (син с диагонални щрихи), SRPO (плътен оранжев), GRPO (оранжев с диагонални щрихи), PPO+Self-reflection (плътен тъмнозелен) и PPO (зелен с диагонални щрихи). За категорията Mathverse стойностите варират приблизително от около 53% (DAPO+Self-reflection) до около 56% (DAPO), като SRPO е около 55.8%, GRPO около 53.5%, PPO+Self-reflection около 53.3% и PPO около 54.5%. За категорията MMLU стойностите се движат приблизително от около 55% (PPO+Self-reflection) до около 57% (DAPO и SRPO), като DAPO+Self-reflection е около 55.8%, GRPO около 56%, а PPO около 56.2%. За категорията Physics стойностите са най-високи, като DAPO достига приблизително 61%, SRPO около 60.5%, DAPO+Self-reflection около 57.5%, GRPO около 58.1%, PPO+Self-reflection около 59.1% и PPO около 56.8%. Стълбите в рамките на всяка група са подредени в един и същ ред, следвайки реда от легендата. Визуалното разграничение между методите се осъществява чрез цвят (син, оранжев, зелен) и текстура (плътни стълби за вариантите със Self-reflection или базовите методи и щриховани стълби за съответните им алтернативи).
raw_responses.Chinese: DESCRIPTION: This grouped bar chart displays accuracy (%) across three benchmark categories—Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics—for six different methods: DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (blue with diagonal hatching), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (orange with diagonal hatching), PPO+Self-reflection (solid dark green), and PPO (green with diagonal hatching). The horizontal axis contains the three category labels (Mathverse, MMLU, Physics), while the vertical axis represents Accuracy (%) with a linear scale ranging from approximately 50% to 62%, with gridlines at every 2 percentage-point interval (52, 54, 56, 58, 60, 62). Within each category group, six bars are arranged side by side in the order listed in the legend. For Mathverse, the bars range from approximately 53.1% (DAPO+Self-reflection) to about 56.1% (DAPO), with SRPO near 55.8%, GRPO near 53.5%, PPO+Self-reflection near 53.3%, and PPO near 54.5%. For MMLU, values range from approximately 55.8% (DAPO) to about 57.0% (DAPO+Self-reflection), with SRPO near 57.1%, GRPO near 56.0%, PPO+Self-reflection near 54.8%, and PPO near 56.2%. For Physics, the values are notably higher, ranging from approximately 56.8% (GRPO) to about 60.5% (SRPO), with DAPO+Self-reflection near 57.5%, DAPO near 58.1%, PPO+Self-reflection near 60.8%, and PPO near 59.1%. The solid-colored bars represent methods with self-reflection or standalone variants (DAPO+Self-reflection, SRPO, PPO+Self-reflection), while the hatched bars represent their counterparts without self-reflection (DAPO, GRPO, PPO). The bars are not sorted in any particular ascending or descending order within each group; rather, they follow a consistent method ordering across all three categories. No bars appear to be visually emphasized beyond the color and hatching distinctions used to differentiate the six methods.
raw_responses.English: DESCRIPTION: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy (%) of six different methods across three benchmark categories: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis contains the three category labels (Mathverse, MMLU, Physics), while the vertical axis represents Accuracy (%) on a linear scale ranging from approximately 50% to 62%, with tick marks at intervals of 2 percentage points. For each category, six bars are grouped together, corresponding to six methods identified in the legend: DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (blue with diagonal hatching), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (orange with diagonal hatching), PPO+Self-reflection (solid dark green), and PPO (green with diagonal hatching). For the Mathverse group, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches approximately 56.1%, DAPO approximately 53.1%, SRPO approximately 55.8%, GRPO approximately 53.5%, PPO+Self-reflection approximately 54.5%, and PPO approximately 53.3%. For the MMLU group, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches approximately 57.0%, DAPO approximately 55.8%, SRPO approximately 57.1%, GRPO approximately 56.0%, PPO+Self-reflection approximately 56.2%, and PPO approximately 54.8%. For the Physics group, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches approximately 57.5%, DAPO approximately 56.2%, SRPO approximately 60.5%, GRPO approximately 58.1%, PPO+Self-reflection approximately 59.1%, and PPO approximately 56.8%. The tallest bar in the chart is SRPO on Physics at approximately 60.5%, while the shortest bar is DAPO on Mathverse at approximately 53.1%. Within each group, the solid-colored bars (representing methods with self-reflection or SRPO) generally appear taller than their hatched counterparts. The bars are not sorted by value but are consistently ordered by method across all three categories.
raw_responses.German: DESCRIPTION: Das Diagramm zeigt die Genauigkeit (Accuracy) in Prozent für sechs verschiedene Methoden über drei Benchmark-Kategorien hinweg: Mathverse, MMLU und Physics. Die horizontale Achse enthält die drei Kategorien, während die vertikale Achse die Genauigkeit in Prozent darstellt, mit einer Skala von 50 % bis 62 % und Tick-Intervallen von 2 Prozentpunkten. Für jede Kategorie sind sechs gruppierte Balken dargestellt, die jeweils einer Methode entsprechen: DAPO+Self-reflection (einfarbig blau), DAPO (blau mit diagonaler Schraffur), SRPO (einfarbig orange), GRPO (orange mit diagonaler Schraffur), PPO+Self-reflection (einfarbig dunkelgrün) und PPO (grün mit diagonaler Schraffur). In der Kategorie Mathverse liegen die Werte zwischen etwa 53,0 % (DAPO) und 56,1 % (DAPO+Self-reflection), wobei SRPO bei etwa 55,8 %, GRPO bei etwa 53,5 %, PPO+Self-reflection bei etwa 53,3 % und PPO bei etwa 54,5 % liegen. In der Kategorie MMLU reichen die Werte von etwa 55,8 % (DAPO) bis 57,0 % (DAPO+Self-reflection), mit SRPO bei etwa 57,1 %, GRPO bei etwa 56,0 %, PPO+Self-reflection bei etwa 54,8 % und PPO bei etwa 56,2 %. In der Kategorie Physics zeigen sich die höchsten Werte insgesamt, wobei DAPO+Self-reflection bei etwa 57,5 %, DAPO bei etwa 58,1 %, SRPO bei etwa 60,5 %, GRPO bei etwa 56,2 %, PPO+Self-reflection bei etwa 56,8 % und PPO bei etwa 59,1 % liegen. Die Balken sind innerhalb jeder Gruppe in der Reihenfolge der Legende von links nach rechts angeordnet, und die Schraffurmuster dienen zur visuellen Unterscheidung der Basisvarianten (DAPO, GRPO, PPO) von ihren jeweiligen erweiterten Versionen (DAPO+Self-reflection, SRPO, PPO+Self-reflection).
